name: Editor
description: Edits rich text with formatting, autosave, and a word count.

dependencies.name: @tiptap/react
dependencies.reason: Optional — enables rich-text mode; without TipTap the editor falls back to a markdown textarea.

dependencies.name: @tiptap/starter-kit
dependencies.reason: Optional — TipTap extension bundle used by rich-text mode.

dependencies.name: @tiptap/extension-link
dependencies.reason: Optional — link formatting in rich-text mode.

formats.description: Which format buttons to show in the toolbar

statusBar.description: Show default status bar with word/character counts

onAutoSave.description: Auto-save callback, called at autoSaveInterval (may be async)

maxLength.description: Maximum character count. Shows counter in status bar with warning (90%) and error (over limit) states

toolbarIcons.description: Optional toolbar icon overrides keyed by format/action (e.g. bold, italic, undo). Values can be React nodes or render functions.

when: Text that needs formatting controls beside it
Drafts that autosave and report a word count
whenNot: Chat or AI prompt input (use Prompt)
guidelines: Compose Editor.Toolbar and Editor.Content to control toolbar layout
Without TipTap it falls back to a markdown-aware textarea
onAutoSave may return a Promise; save status updates once it settles
size sets the minimum body height: sm 120px, md 200px, lg 400px
maxLength drives the counter's warning and over-limit states
Headings, blockquote, orderedList, undo, and redo are opt-in via formats
toolbarIcons swaps glyphs without changing labels or keyboard behavior
accessibility: Format buttons use aria-pressed to indicate active state
Action buttons (undo/redo) omit aria-pressed since they are not toggles
Status indicator uses aria-live="polite" for save status announcements
Keyboard shortcuts match standard text editor conventions (Ctrl+B, Ctrl+I, etc.)
Global shortcuts (e.g., Sidebar Ctrl+B) automatically yield when focus is inside the Editor
Focus ring appears on the editor container when any child element is focused

examples.name: Default
examples.description: Toolbar and status bar you get with no configuration.

examples.name: With Auto-Save and Publish
examples.description: Save state sits next to the primary action in the toolbar.
examples.code:
<Editor
  placeholder="Start typing your masterpiece here..."
  onValueChange={(v) => console.log(v)}
>
  <Editor.Toolbar>
    <Editor.ToolbarGroup aria-label="Text formatting">
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="bold" />
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="italic" />
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="strikethrough" />
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="link" />
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="code" />
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="bulletList" />
    </Editor.ToolbarGroup>
    <Editor.ToolbarGroup aria-label="Actions">
      <Editor.StatusIndicator status="saved" />
      <Button variant="accent" size="sm">
        Publish
      </Button>
    </Editor.ToolbarGroup>
  </Editor.Toolbar>
  <Editor.Content />
  <Editor.StatusBar showWordCount showCharCount />
</Editor>

examples.name: Save Failed
examples.description: A failed autosave turns the status text red.
examples.code:
<Editor defaultValue="This draft could not be saved.">
  <Editor.Toolbar>
    <Editor.ToolbarGroup aria-label="Text formatting">
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="bold" />
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="italic" />
    </Editor.ToolbarGroup>
    <Editor.ToolbarGroup aria-label="Status">
      <Editor.StatusIndicator status="error" />
    </Editor.ToolbarGroup>
  </Editor.Toolbar>
  <Editor.Content />
  <Editor.StatusBar showWordCount showCharCount />
</Editor>

examples.name: Disabled
examples.description: Dimmed and inert, but the text stays readable.
examples.code:
<Editor
  defaultValue="This content cannot be edited."
  disabled
/>

examples.name: Read Only
examples.description: Text can be selected and copied, but never changed.
examples.code:
<Editor
  defaultValue="This content is read-only. You can select and copy text but cannot modify it."
  readOnly
/>

examples.name: Custom Toolbar
examples.description: Separators split the controls into labelled clusters.
examples.code:
<Editor
  placeholder="Write your blog post..."
  onValueChange={(v) => console.log(v)}
>
  <Editor.Toolbar>
    <Editor.ToolbarGroup aria-label="Basic formatting">
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="bold" />
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="italic" />
    </Editor.ToolbarGroup>
    <Editor.Separator />
    <Editor.ToolbarGroup aria-label="Advanced formatting">
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="link" />
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="code" />
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="bulletList" />
    </Editor.ToolbarGroup>
    <Editor.ToolbarGroup aria-label="Status">
      <Editor.StatusIndicator status="saving" />
    </Editor.ToolbarGroup>
  </Editor.Toolbar>
  <Editor.Content />
  <Editor.StatusBar showWordCount showCharCount />
</Editor>

examples.name: Full Formatting
examples.description: Every opt-in format switched on, at the tallest preset.
examples.code:
<Editor
  placeholder="Write an article..."
  size="lg"
>
  <Editor.Toolbar>
    <Editor.ToolbarGroup aria-label="History">
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="undo" />
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="redo" />
    </Editor.ToolbarGroup>
    <Editor.Separator />
    <Editor.ToolbarGroup aria-label="Headings">
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="heading1" />
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="heading2" />
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="heading3" />
    </Editor.ToolbarGroup>
    <Editor.Separator />
    <Editor.ToolbarGroup aria-label="Text formatting">
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="bold" />
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="italic" />
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="strikethrough" />
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="code" />
    </Editor.ToolbarGroup>
    <Editor.Separator />
    <Editor.ToolbarGroup aria-label="Block formatting">
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="bulletList" />
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="orderedList" />
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="blockquote" />
      <Editor.ToolbarButton format="link" />
    </Editor.ToolbarGroup>
  </Editor.Toolbar>
  <Editor.Content />
  <Editor.StatusBar showWordCount showCharCount />
</Editor>

examples.name: With Character Limit
examples.description: The counter warns near 280 characters and turns red past it.
examples.code:
<Editor
  placeholder="Write a tweet-sized message..."
  maxLength={280}
  size="sm"
  formats={['bold', 'italic', 'link']}
/>

examples.name: Small Size
examples.description: A 120px body with a trimmed toolbar, for tight spaces.

relations.note: Prompt is for AI/chat input; Editor is for long-form content editing
Use Textarea for simple multi-line input without formatting toolbar
Use Input for single-line text input

propsSummary: toolbar: boolean - show default toolbar (default: true)
statusBar: boolean - show word/char counts (default: true)
onAutoSave: (value: string) => void | Promise<void> - auto-save handler
maxLength: number - character limit with visual indicator
toolbarIcons: Partial<Record<EditorFormat, ReactNode | (state) => ReactNode>> - custom toolbar icons
